# Upload checklist: {{TITLE}} (manual, optional)

The skill never uploads. Do this yourself in YouTube Studio when you are happy with the video.

- [ ] Watch `out/<slug>-9x16.mp4` once on your phone. Can you read every word? Do the replays loop?
- [ ] Studio > Create > Upload video > choose `out/<slug>-9x16.mp4` (vertical and 25 s or less, so it becomes a Short).
- [ ] Title: starts with a verb, under 60 characters, true to the video. Never "1 prompt" or "one prompt".
  - Title ideas:
- [ ] Description: one line on what it teaches, the source of the fact, then `#Shorts`.
- [ ] Audience: "No, it's not made for kids", unless it really is.
- [ ] Altered or synthetic content: animated cartoon, so "No" is usually right. If unsure, choose "Yes".
- [ ] Sound (optional): add a track from YouTube's audio library in the Shorts editor. The video itself is silent.
- [ ] Visibility: Private or Unlisted first. Check it on your phone, then publish.
- [ ] The 16:9 version (`out/<slug>-16x9.mp4`) is for a long video or a post, not this Short.
